hints.title: Binary Tree Independent Set
hints.text: Two directly linked houses cannot both be robbed. At each node, decide between robbing that node or skipping it.

hints.title: Two-State Subproblem Decomposition
hints.text: From each subtree, return a pair of values: the maximum amount if the root of the subtree is robbed, and the maximum amount if it is not.

hints.title: Bottom-Up State Transitions
hints.text: If the current house is robbed, neither child can be robbed: take node value plus not-robbed left plus not-robbed right. If the current house is skipped, each child can be either robbed or skipped: take max left plus max right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in binary tree
complexity.notes: Single post-order traversal passing two-element tuple.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Top-down recursion without memoization re-evaluates grandchildren exponentially O(2^N).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Returning a pair of states per node eliminates all duplicate subproblems.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use post-order traversal returning (rob, not_rob) to achieve O(N) linear time.
